facts.fact: The Fonds de Service Universel des TIC's revised procurement plan for FY2025/26 (published by the finance ministry) budgets BIF 4,811,751,000 for three pilot Villages Numeriques in Bujumbura, Gitega and Buhumuza; the document is the fund's plan, not the state budget law.

The Fonds de Service Universel des TIC, funded by a 1% levy on operators' turnover under decree 100/054 of 29 March 2024 (restructuring decree 100/186 of 16 October 2017), pays for three pilot Villages Numeriques at BIF 4,811,751,000 in its revised FY2025/26 plan, plus six new telecentres and fibre connections.
